v.bridge.tap-vowels.text: Tap every vowel sound in the word. A team of letters is one sound.

v.bridge.try-vowel.text: Look again. Which letters make a vowel sound?

v.bridge.vowels-glow.text: The vowel sounds are glowing. Tap them.

v.bridge.silent-e.text: This e is silent. It helps the vowel before it.

v.bridge.pick-split.text: Now tap the gap where the word breaks into parts.

v.bridge.split-again.text: Not that gap yet. Look at the consonants between the vowels.

v.bridge.split-shown.text: Watch. This is where the word breaks.

v.bridge.flip.text: Some words break two ways. Flip the split and listen for the real word.

v.bridge.name-planks.text: Now name each plank. Which clan does it belong to?

v.bridge.which-clan.text: Look at the vowel. How is it held? Then pick the clan.

v.bridge.read-planks.text: Read each plank, one at a time.

v.bridge.walk.text: Walk the bridge. Read the whole word.

v.bridge.protege-try.text: Ooh, let me try one! I split this word all by myself...

v.bridge.protege-ask.text: Is this right? Tap the gap where it really breaks.

v.bridge.protege-thanks.text: Oh! Thank you! Now I know it.
